verdicts.reason: A breaks the design apart. The red quote panel's lower half is empty. The skyline is shrunk to a small thumbnail floating in a separate white box on the right, so it no longer anchors the text. A stray decorative line runs under 'MODERN', and the author name drifts off to the side of the quote. B is the original shrunk unchanged into the left half of the canvas, leaving the right half as dead grey space and the text small. B is still the less bad of the two because it keeps the original composition and its skyline-over-quote feel.
